When you closed the door, the School Nurse gave a single nod and went away.{w}
Summoner

"Summoners like me get a bit of a cold shoulder at this school.{w}Just look at that -- the Magic Research Wing."{w}{p}"Kathleen, the vice principal... being so keen on teaching is fine and all, but...{w}I just wish she'd pay the other departments a little more attention too."{w}{p}"Hey, you lot, want me to tell you something interesting about Summoners?"{w}
note: Accuracy: source has Kathleen as the one who should look at the other departments (mo sukoshi dake hoka no gakka mo mite hoshii); subject restored (Kathleen female per glossary).

en: Hear them out?

"Good, good. Sure thing."{w}{p}"See, summoned monsters, when you combine them with items, can be put to work in a couple of unexpected ways."{w}{p}"The first is merging with an item.{w}For example, the Cloak of Corruption and a Succubus."{w}{p}"If you've got both, try unleashing the Cloak of Corruption's hidden power while you've got a Succubus summoned."{w}{p}"Something wonderful's bound to happen!"{w}{p}"The second is boosting an item's effect."{w}{p}"For example, if you have a Unicorn Horn equipped while you've got a Unicorn summoned, it gets even more powerful."{w}{p}"And it's not just the examples I gave here -- there seem to be all sorts, so if you've got a Summoner, go looking!"{w}{p}"..........{w}Maaan, it's been ages since I got to talk about this stuff.{w}Summoning really is the best!!"{w}
note: Item names Cloak of Corruption (daraku no manto) and Unicorn Horn are provisional (not in glossary).

en: "Ugh...{w}F-fine, then...{w}So I get the cold shoulder here too..."{w}
There is a bulletin board for the Magic Research Wing.{w}

Notice board kept as a 3-line * box; check width in game (longest line 51 chars).

en: The grenade exploded!!{w}

Year 3 Female Student
"Doesn't Kathleen piss you off?{w}Like, are Mages really such hot stuff? Give me a break."{w}
Year 2 Male Student

"Well, sure, it's the star department of this school."{w}{p}"But us in the Priest department, who save people's lives, and the Alchemy department, which is useful in everyday life -- they could give us a bit more support, couldn't they?"{w}
"'Miracles that borrow the power of the gods? Upset the gods and it's all over, isn't it?' -- that's what Kathleen said!"{w}
note: datte sa (quoted speech) has no named subject; the quoted remark is Kathleen's (scene is about her, feminine ja nai). Name restored.

en: Year 1 Female Student
"Uh, uh, um, you two...{w}Maybe you shouldn't badmouth a teacher so much...{w}*fluster, fluster*..."{w}
note: senpai-gata rendered 'you two' (speaking to the two older students).

en: "Maybe I'd have been better off going to Semnadoc instead."{w}
"Over there, though, there's the Archbishop, y'know..."{w}
"Oh, right."{w}
"I'd love to knock Kathleen down a peg.{w}Isn't there some way..."{w}
"*fluster, fluster*... *fluster, fluster*..."{w}
"What if we got Professor Harmoni to blast the door of that oh-so-precious Magic Research Wing with a grenade... or something? How about it?"{w}
note: Source says majutsu RENKIN-tou (Magic Alchemy Wing) here, but every other row (3245, 3249, 3294, 3300) is the Research Wing and the plan is carried out on that door; treated as a source slip. Accuracy check.

en: "Even Professor Harmoni wouldn't do that for us, I bet."{w}{p}"Maybe we get a grenade and set it ourselves...{w}Nah, Harmoni's pretty strict about that stuff.{w}Might not hand one over for free."{w}
"If we just handed over some sweets, Harmoni would jump at it, right?{w}Going, 'Yaaay, it's a Mont Blaaanc~~~!' and all!"{w}
note: Subject (Harmoni) restored from 3274.

Use Prof. Harmoni's grenade?

en: After making sure no one was around, you set Professor Harmoni's grenade on the door!{w}
"This is the Magic Research Wing!{w}The castle of the Mages, led by our very own Vice Principal Kathleen!"{w}
Witch
"Have you met Professor Nambino, up in the northwest?{w}If you haven't yet, go on over!!"{w}
Vice Principal Kathleen
note: Glossary name box, 23 chars (over ~16); kept, needs width check.

en: "Hello there.{w}I don't recognize your faces -- are you new students?{w}Do apply yourselves, won't you."{w}

"So it seems some youngster blew up the entrance to the Magic Research Wing..."{w}{p}"If they had to, I'd at least have liked them to blow it up with {11:0001:0015}, not a grenade."{w}{p}"...I hold every scrap of information in this school in my grasp without ever leaving my seat.{w}Every room except that person's."{w}{p}"Who is doing what, and where -- I see it all, you know...?{w}Well, I understand how you feel. It does look like favoritism, doesn't it."{w}{p}"Enlarging the Magic Research Wing and putting effort into the Mage classes doesn't mean we're neglecting the other disciplines."{w}{p}"Mage spells alone can grow in power without limit, on nothing more than the caster's state of mind.{w}Unless you understand them properly and learn them right, they're dangerous."{w}{p}"The more power someone holds, the hardest thing of all is restraining themselves.{w}That is why we nurture sound theory and a sound heart."{w}{p}"And as I gathered all sorts of materials for that purpose, the building ended up this big."{w}{p}"Yes, I suppose it's about time I gave you some instruction as well."{w}{p}"...I'll teach you that there are things you ought to learn before you go playing with grenades."{w}{p}"Rejoice. You get to take a special class from Kathleen, no less."{w}
note: ano kata ('that person', honorific) left unnamed - presumably the Board Chair. 'from Kathleen, no less' renders kono Kyasuriin kara (self-reference by name), kept gender-neutral; note Kamikaze calls Kathleen onago (woman) in slice 055 (3369) while the glossary says unknown.

en: Take the special class?

"Lecture One.{w}The role of the spirits, and the truth about {11:0001:0015}."{w}{p}"{11:0001:0015} -- famed as the strongest attack spell of us Mages.{w}It's commonly understood as a nuclear-blast spell."{w}{p}"But in truth, this spell is not an explosion.{w}What it really is, in other words..."{w}{p}"{11:0001:0015} in the narrow sense is a space-control spell: 'a spell that prepares an environment where a High Mana Source can be created.'"{w}{p}"A flow of magic power surrounds our land.{w}It's fluid, like air pressure and the wind, and the Elementals and Fairies manage it."{w}{p}"From here on, I'll call the Elementals and Fairies 'spirits' for short."{w}{p}"They keep it in balance, so magic power doesn't pool in one spot and no place ends up extremely thin on it."{w}{p}"That's why, when we cast a spell, we can always expect the same effect, without feeling any difference."{w}{p}"Why do the spirits do this?{w}Apparently even they don't entirely know..."{w}{p}"The prevailing theory is that the gods told the spirits to even out magic power and cap it, so the land won't break in some accident... or so it's said."{w}{p}"But every so often, through some fluke, released magic power exceeds the land's limit.{w}That is a High Mana Source."{w}{p}"Making a High Mana Source is simple. Just set off several attack spells at once, in one spot."{w}{p}"Do that, and the released magic powers interfere, and in no time an explosion beyond the limit breaks out.{w}But in reality, if you try it, it fizzles."{w}{p}"Why is that?{w}Because the spirits disperse the magic power so it won't exceed the limit."{w}{p}"Slipping past the spirits' watch to create a space where you can fire off as many spells as you like -- that is the truth about {11:0001:0015}."{w}{p}"So in theory, even an intermediate Mage could bring the land to ruin, if the spirits weren't keeping watch."{w}
note: koumagen = 'High Mana Source', kakugeki = 'nuclear-blast' (new terms). {11:0001:0015} is the top nuclear spell insert.; compressed for the 2 KB message buffer

en: "Well, are you keeping up?{w}Shall I explain it once more?"{w}
Hear the explanation again?
"Then, shall we continue?"{w}

"Lecture Two.{w}How to cast {11:0001:0015}."{w}{p}"In the broad sense, {11:0001:0015} breaks down into five spells."{w}{p}"First, {11:0001:0015} in the narrow sense.{w}The high-tier fire spell {11:0001:000F};{w}the high-tier ice spell {11:0001:0012};"{w}{p}"the high-tier lightning spell {11:0001:0013};{w}and the teleport spell {11:0001:0016}."{w}{p}"Into the place made with {11:0001:0015}, fire the three attack spells at once.{w}The more simultaneous, the greater the power."{w}{p}"But {11:0001:0015} has one problem.{w}You can't pin down where it takes effect."{w}{p}"It secures a High Mana Source site by slipping past the spirits' watch, so you can't just set it up wherever you please."{w}{p}"Back when magic research was young, even that was a threat."{w}{p}"If precision wasn't needed, as in wars between nations, it was practical enough.{w}A nuisance of a big move that hit friend and foe alike, though."{w}{p}"So further research proposed combining it with {11:0001:0016}."{w}{p}"The method: wherever the High Mana Source forms, swap the space with {11:0001:0016} and set it off where you like."{w}{p}"At first, people laughed at the theory, since it used too much magic power."{w}{p}"But once it was known to work in practice, not just on paper, and to go off wherever you liked, everyone studied how to optimize it."{w}{p}"The result is the practical {11:0001:0015} we use today."{w}{p}"Frankly, the spirits really hate it."{w}{p}"But since mastering {11:0001:0016} was made a requirement, they've come to turn a blind eye."{w}{p}"So, as for the order of learning Mage spells..."{w}{p}"leaving {11:0001:0016} until after {11:0001:0015} is not recommended at all."{w}{p}"I mean, not being able to control where the explosion goes once it's set off -- that's far too scary, isn't it?"{w}{p}"This whole process -- lifting the limit on magic power to draw out a nuclear blast -- would never be allowed if it went through the gods."{w}{p}"It's a spell only we Mages can cast, since we call on the higher world's power directly, not through the gods."{w}
note: kokuninshite kureru you ni natta: spirits are the subject ('came to tolerate it'); now rendered with the spirits as subject ('they've come to turn a blind eye').; compressed for the 2 KB message buffer; accuracy: note updated to match the en (no text change).

en: "Lecture Three.{w}A greater power: the Ultimate Mana Source."{w}{p}"You understand how a High Mana Source works, yes?{w}Well, set off three {11:0001:0015} at once, and..."{w}{p}"you'd get a theorized Ultimate Mana Source.{w}It's a forbidden arcane experiment no one in this land has tried yet."{w}{p}"You set all three {11:0001:0015} at the same coordinates at once."{w}{p}"Picture {11:0001:0015}'s three attack spells all as {11:0001:0015} -- then you see its power, no?"{w}{p}"...Though I can't quite grasp how terrifying it is.{w}It's just too huge."{w}{p}"There are several predictions of what follows.{w}Let's go through them one by one."{w}{p}"The Waltames Conjecture.{w}Once one forms, a colossal blast engulfs the whole land and all turns to ash."{w}{p}"...Researchers dislike it as far too simple.{w}It'd be sad if that solved a mystery so many years old, no?"{w}{p}"Minutes of the Fourth Magic Summit.{w}It can't sustain itself; it contracts sharply and vanishes with the magic power around it."{w}{p}"Unresolved: can dense, contracted magic power really vanish at no cost?{w}Clear that, though, and the theory is complete."{w}{p}"The Carnier Conjecture.{w}The gods erase the land 'the moment anyone tries to make' one."{w}{p}"Carnier was a theologian, so: cross the gods' limits and of course they'll get angry."{w}{p}"The Mittneil Hypothesis.{w}Its spatial destruction ends the spirits' hold on magic, so any spell can be cast endlessly in the land."{w}{p}"Given {11:0001:0017}'s example, it's easy for us to accept.{w}It's the most supported one now."{w}{p}"That's about it, I suppose?{w}Now, which theory do you believe?{w}Or will you propose your own?"{w}{p}"So, back to the start....{w}As you see, magic research goes hand in hand with danger."{w}{p}"If a mistake only killed you, fine. What's scary is it could even collapse the land..."{w}{p}"So even if everyone hates it, I gather all the information and material I can. I want the students to know."{w}
note: New names: Ultimate Mana Source (gokumagen), Waltames, Carnier, Mittneil, Fourth Magic Summit. 'three {0015}' kept bare: the insert is a spell name, so no plural s.; compressed for the 2 KB message buffer; Accuracy: restored 'yet' (mada).

en: "And that's the end of the lecture.{w}Well? Want to hear it once more?"{w}
"Phew..."{w}{p}"......"{w}{p}"Hee hee, I'm sorry.{w}I talked far too much in one go.{w}And I have a lecture coming up, too. What am I going to do?"{w}
Kathleen poured water from a pitcher into a cup and took a breather.{w}
"Well, that's about the gist of it.{w}Study hard, won't you.{w}If you don't understand, I'll teach you again."{w}
"Oh, is that so.{w}I look forward to seeing how far you get on your own."{w}{p}"But life isn't long enough to rediscover everything from zero, you know?"{w}

"Oh my, you there.
What's with that rather jolly getup?"{w}{p}"Goodness, it's cursed, isn't it?{w}That equipment is... from Caron's shop?{w}Hmm, so in other words... you've come to challenge us."{w}{p}"Very well.{w}If you can defeat us, we will stock the Caron brand at the school store."{w}
note: gokigen na kakkou: the party is wearing Caron's cursed prototype gear (slice 030).

"What is it, Vice Principal?{w}And just when I was in the middle of a fun, fun remedial lesson, too."{w}
Special Advisor Kamikaze

en: "And what might you want with this Kamikaze?"{w}
Head of Year McMahon

en: "Summoning the faculty? That hardly bodes well."{w}
"Do you remember Caron, who came by the other day?"{w}
"Yes. The cute one from the item shop, right?"{w}
"As I recall, the one who wanted to sell goods through our school store, or some such..."{w}
"Don't remember!{w}I never carry memories past sundown!!"{w}

en: "That child has come to challenge us.{w}Although it seems these young ones will be fighting on their behalf."{w}{p}"If they can beat us, our school store will carry the Caron brand."{w}
"Sounds interesting.{w}Let's put this Caron brand to the test and see what it's really worth."{w}
